name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.mem_withExponents_of_deep
summary: The value of x at (a, μ) has all Galois differences in t^{hi}B_dR^+, so it is congruent to a constant c of Q̄_p; a constant in t^mB_dR^+ with m > 0 is 0.

steps.claim: The Kisin and letter conditions are those of hx.

For a, u ∈ U_{σ^{−a}(i)} and μ of type u: g·V − V = valueAt(L, a, μ, g·x − x) ∈ hodgeFil(hi(a, u)) for every g ∈ Γ' (valueAt_smul_sub, H), V = valueAt(L, a, μ, x); hence V − c ∈ hodgeFil(hi(a, u)) for some c ∈ Q̄_p (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem). Let m = improvedExponent(lo, hi)(a, u) = min(hi(a, u), hi(a, u) if lo(a, u) > 0 else 0). As m ≤ hi(a, u), V − c ∈ hodgeFil(m), so it suffices that c ∈ hodgeFil(m). If m ≤ 0 this holds, c ∈ Q̄_p ⊆ B_dR^+ = hodgeFil(0) ⊆ hodgeFil(m). If m > 0, then lo(a, u) > 0 and hi(a, u) > 0 (a case split: lo(a, u) > 0 alone does not make min(lo, hi) positive), so c = V − (V − c) ∈ hodgeFil(min(lo(a, u), hi(a, u))) (V ∈ hodgeFil(lo(a, u)) by hx) has a positive index, and c = 0 (qpBar_mem_hodgeFil_iff). (So: hi ≤ lo and lo > 0 give the old bound hi; hi > lo > 0 make c vanish; lo ≤ 0 gives min(hi, 0).)
